feedback.answered: Two independent implementation obligations are confirmed in the captured snapshot. CheckRun 3c9d7e6ae7a04f4f9ce7a782e755960a confirms that VerifyLeader can complete confirmed when the leader has only its own voter contact against a two-voter quorum and a configured non-voter answers the verification heartbeat; the shared vote counter accepts that non-voter confirmation. CheckRun 84aeffcaf772412e93f040b18483d2b5 confirms that when one FSM value implements both BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore, a committed LogConfiguration entry reaches ApplyBatch while StoreConfiguration is never invoked, contrary to the ConfigurationStore callback contract. Both executions exited 0, produced complete violating witnesses, and their direct-check correspondence and applicability conditions were reviewed and resolved.
remaining: Test whether a stale or delayed TimeoutNow request can disrupt a healthy leader because TimeoutNowRequest carries no term and timeoutNow unconditionally clears the leader and enters Candidate state.

Test whether installSnapshot can leave a divergent post-snapshot log suffix or stale cached last-log state because it updates lastApplied, snapshot, and configuration state but does not explicitly truncate or reset all later log state.
Test the appendEntries storage-failure branch where a conflicting suffix is deleted successfully and StoreLogs then fails; the code comment notes that r.getLastLog may be left in the wrong state.
Clarify whether AddNonvoter's treatment of an existing Voter, which updates only the address and leaves suffrage unchanged, matches the API contract or should be a demotion.
